proposal.hypothesis: The selected parent retains split source ranges, rsqrtf, and factor-eight unrolling. This experiment changes only the final velocity arithmetic: for target masses whose reciprocal remains in the normal finite range, compute one reciprocal and reuse it across the three force components; retain the original component-wise division outside that range. Reusing the reciprocal may reduce repeated divisions, but compiler common-subexpression handling and changed rounding could erase the benefit or affect correctness. No speedup is assumed before controller validation.
